metadata.note: THE IMPULSE BANK (DEC-37; PLAN.md 1.6, 14.7): 68 impulses, one per row of bank/impulse_bank.json, a mic opening over each — played through once with the engine up, the batch is in the bank under the rows' names (bfl-impulse-7 … 18 · bcl-impulse-7 … 18 · perc-impulse-7 … 26 · va-impulse-7 … 18 · vc-impulse-7 … 18). Part two, from 100.3 s: 3 return bricks per sample, each dealt a preset (tools/deal_variants.js) — the processed versions, rendered by the engine right after each capture. GENERATED by tools/build_impulse_bank.js; a change goes into bank/impulse_bank.json, then the tool with --replace, the deal again, File ▾ → Reload.
